headline: Parex Resources Receives Approval to List on Colombia Stock Exchange
summary: Parex Resources has received regulatory approval to register its shares on the Colombia Stock Exchange, while maintaining its listing in Toronto.
why: Parex is a significant independent oil and gas producer in Colombia; its listing increases local market liquidity and investment options.

impacts.name: Parex Resources
impacts.why: New listing provides additional access to capital and liquidity.
